label: early original-phase input of h/1/m/v/j/k (steps 2-5)
explanation: Reset-gate unit active almost only in the original (input) phase. It fires when the input is one of six tokens (h, 1, m, v, j, k), at positions 2-5, peaking at t=3. It never fires at t=0-1 or in the copy phase. A small amount (3%) fires on <DEL> in short sequences. Strongest when in_tok=h and the sequence starts with s or r (first_tok s gives 2.8x lift). Weaker on repeat occurrences (in_first=0) and at later positions (t>=6). Misses come from other tokens (o, b, 2, <DEL>) firing weakly. False positives are trigger tokens at positions where context suppresses it. Dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.87.
